notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Small Update, Development Status Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
New:

 New Location: 45 Colen Road. A medium sized single story house in the countryside that you'll find on your way to Craptonne farmhouse
 Furniture will now... bounce when you search them? Yeah, bounce.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where one of the TV prefabs would transform into the other after being turned on


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806649/565b14aa979dadf0bd0516420c907247cc25b1c1.png

Development Status

To be completely transparent with you guys, I'm no longer planning to work any further on this game. I only really wanted people to play this, and since this game didn't really gain any attention my motivation to keep working on it has worn out. This update is pretty much just stuff that was laying around that I decided to finish off.

The game's pricing: 7.99USD seemed like fair price when I was planning on releasing content updates for the game, but since that's not happening anymore I've decided to drop the price down to 4.99USD permanently 

Now for the two people still playing this game, this all might be very disappointing news. But I will try to continue checking bug reports and I will fix any issues that come up. And if Paranormal Home Invaders somehow manages to develop even a niche audience, I might decided to start working on content updates again. Until then, I'm going to work on other things that I'm interested in.

Have fun playing the new location, and thank you to everyone who played Paranormal Home Invaders.

notes.title: Version 0.7.1 Patch 1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
[olist]
 Ghost line of sight now works properly, or it works enough to be able to kill the player
 Benjamin Circuit hiding spots are now to all automatically blocked
 To avoid future problems, hiding spot blockers get auto disabled before getting activated
 Some Benjamin hiding spot blockers are fixed so that the player can't se the hiding spot while the blocker is active. There were only a few hiding spots were this applied
 Binding necklace is removed from entrance of Benjamin Circuit
 Doorways in Benjamin Circuit are now fixed so they are no longer vertical
 Dominion Avenue house lights are no longer disabled
 To avoid future mistakes, there is now a script that makes sure that light source holders are always active
 Pillow Street Garage room triggers are now fixed
 Network Prefabs that were previously missing, are now added to the network prefabs ScrO
 Activity Monitor starting state is now correct. It didn't have a Network Object component yet never logged any errors?
 Fixed name tag bug where client (not host) would see their own name on other people's name tags
 Fixed bug where clients could not remove equipment that they added unless the host either aaded a piece of equipment or selected the equipment the client wanted to remove
 Can no longer swap equipment for a tier that the player does not have unlocked
 Ghost kill animation is fixed
 Player death particles improved so that player shouldn't see
 Video cameras can not be picked up again after already holding it
 UV Glowstick can not be picked up again after already holding it
[/olist]
